problem: Choose a frontend framework for a new internal admin tool
context: A small team will build and maintain it. The tool has about 20 screens of forms and tables.

options.summary: React with Vite and a component library
Vue 3 with Vite and a component library

criteria.description: The team can build and change screens quickly
Easy to maintain and hire for over several years

expected.why: All three are viable; the deciding fact (what the team already knows) isn't stated.
